Fifteen comments

From Kevin Burke’s “Learn to Play Irish Fiddle” video tape one (as a set with Micko Russell’s Slide). A beginner’s tune but still tasty, methinks.

It seems different from John O’Leary’s slide. Can anybody help me with any other recorded versions, tune origin etc?

↳ Posted by fidkid on October 21st, 2004.

Try the “Eavesdropper”

I’m sure this is on the Kevin Burke/Jackie Daly recording “The Eavesdropper” recording. There is a set with a “Johnny Leary’s” followed by “Miko Russell’s ” slides on it.

↳ Posted by Kenny on October 21st, 2004.

Low?

Are you sure this isn’t “ a string” too low?

↳ Posted by Kenny on October 21st, 2004.

Low?

Can’t say as to Eavesdropper version but this is pretty much as he teaches it on the video. Moving it over/up a string is a great idea though.

↳ Posted by fidkid on October 21st, 2004.

Thanks for the memories ‘fidkid’ - a dear old favourite:

I have it not so low, and the following transcript is just bare bones.

K:Gmaj
|:DEF|G2e dBG F2A E2A|F2A DEF G2D DEF|G2e dBG F2A E2A|FAF DEF G3:|
|:G2B|d2B g2B d2c A2B|cBc e2d B2d G2B|d2B g2B d2c A2g|fed CBA G3:|
|:d3|fed c2e e2d B2d|ded cBA G2A B2d|fed c2e e2d B2d|fed cBA G3:|

That’s just now, right off the top of my head. I haven’t trolled my old notes yet so I’m not sure where I first picked this up or where I played it, but I’ve spend some time in the Sliabh Luachra area, including with the O’Leary’s and friends, dancing too it as well. I find I play it a few different ways, not just variations and ornamentation, but always this key. I’ll do a search and come back with anything if I luck out, including any alternate keys or names I might come across.

↳ Posted by ceolachan on October 21st, 2004.

O’Keeffe’s (If Only I Had A Womaneen)

I found this among a stack of written tunes I was sorting. It had the title “If Only I had a Womaneen” and I couldn’t find a reference to it under that title. Dargai (a Session member) located it in Henrik Norbek’s site (http://www.norbeck.nu/abc/index.asp) where it was identified as yet another of O’Keefe’s slides. I’d appreciate any info anyone could provide about how it got the name “If Only I had a Womaneen”.

↳ Posted by Muircheartaigh on May 5th, 2018.

Re: John Leary’s

On the album Eavesdropper, Jackie Daly and Kevin Burke play this in the key of Bb, presumably to suit the accordion Jackie is playing.
